Geographic Footprint

Areas We Serve: Jharkhand & West Bengal

Deep roots and operational reach across key industrial belts, commercial metros, and educational hubs.

State 01

Jharkhand

Comprehensive transport corridors, industrial land deals, student placement, and marketing across major mineral and industrial belts:

  • Ranchi: Capital hub for education counselling, institutional admissions & regional land development.
  • Jamshedpur (Tatanagar): Industrial transport logistics, factory goods movement & commercial joint ventures.
  • Dhanbad & Bokaro: Heavy minerals freight, logistics support, and commercial land sales.
  • Deoghar & Hazaribagh: Retail marketing, educational admissions, and residential land plots.
State 02

West Bengal

Headquartered in Sector V Kolkata with extensive coverage of port connectivity, real estate ventures, and commercial branding:

  • Kolkata (Sector V & Metros): Agency headquarters, IT hub marketing, university placements, and prime commercial joint work.
  • Howrah & Hooghly: Transport depot corridors, freight transit & industrial warehousing land.
  • Haldia: Direct port export facilitation, customs coordination, and maritime goods transport.
  • Durgapur & Asansol: Steel belt logistics, commercial properties & institutional marketing.
  • Siliguri & North Bengal: Strategic gateway transport and educational placement network.
